text: Apple Accounts and iCloud sign-ins appear to be experiencing issues, according to multiple social media reports and Apple's System Status page . Apple says ‌iCloud‌ Account and Sign In may be slow or experiencing issues, but there are no other outages listed on the site. There are also reports on social media about Apple retail stores and other services like Apple Music and Apple Pay experiencing issues. Anything related to an Apple Account seems to be malfunctioning, with users unable to sign in. Update 1:10 p.m. ET: Apple's System Status page is listing outages for App Store , ‌Apple Music‌, and AppleCare on Device, along with the ‌iCloud‌ account issue. The developer status page lists outages for Accounts, ‌App Store‌ Connect, the ‌Apple Music‌ API, ‌Apple Music‌ Connect, and Apple Podcasts Connect.
